scope.serving: 86 fixed shape requests, random input IDs; one trace per configuration; not capacity proof
scope.full_model: fixed-prefix next-token fixture, graph replay; not autoregressive serving
scope.transfer: controlled constant data sized by Qwen3-8B configuration; H2D and same-host P2P, not cross-node RDMA
scope.chartqa: 64 stratified real-image questions, four visual-token caps; HF single-request diagnostic, not tuned serving or a trained controller

numerical_gate: full-model relative logits RMSE <=0.02 and same greedy token; sampled, not long-generation quality
